title: Implement Automated Resource Quarantine for Persistent Threats
description: The ProdSecure Orchestrator currently supports immediate, specific remediation actions like blocking an IP or restarting a service. However, it lacks a mechanism for handling persistent, low-grade threats where a resource (e.g., a web server node) is suspected of being compromised but the exact vector is unknown. The security team requires a new 'Quarantine' capability. When a resource is quarantined, it should be isolated from the production network to prevent lateral movement, while simultaneously triggering a forensic data collection runbook. This task involves implementing this entire feature, from domain modeling to infrastructure-level changes, over several development sessions.

project_spec.name: ProdSecure Orchestrator
project_spec.description:
ProdSecure Orchestrator is an enterprise-grade, PHP-based system-security productivity suite designed around the MVVM pattern to streamline DevSecOps workflows. The application unifies alerting, performance metrics, backup & recovery, deployment automation, load balancing, system monitoring, security scanning, and log aggregation into a single, operator-friendly command center. While typical security dashboards concentrate solely on threat visibility, ProdSecure Orchestrator boosts productivity by embedding drag-and-drop run-books, smart scheduling, and context-aware remediation wizards directly into the view layer so that SecOps teams can transform insights into actions in seconds rather than hours.

Built for large, distributed environments, the solution leverages Service Mesh principles to treat every security or monitoring micro-service as a first-class, discoverable resource. The ViewModel surfaces real-time data streams (Observer Pattern) that drive adaptive UI widgets: interactive topology maps, backlog kanban boards, and SLA heatmaps. Meanwhile, behind the scenes, a Chain of Responsibility routes every event—whether an intrusion detection alert, a failed backup, or a sudden CPU spike—through a customizable pipeline of Strategy Pattern handlers that decide, throttle, and escalate. Command Pattern objects encapsulate remediation steps, enabling safe rollback, audit trails, and one-click automation directly from the productivity-focused dashboard.
dependencies: Laminas-MVVM (community package providing formal MVVM helpers)
ReactPHP (non-blocking event loop for real-time streams)
RoadRunner or Swoole (high-performance PHP application server, load balancing)
Ansible Runner SDK (deployment_automation via Command Pattern wrappers)
OWASP Dependency-Check CLI via PHP wrappers (security_scanning)
Kubernetes PHP client (service mesh interactions & rollout orchestration)
Redis (Observer pub/sub channels for live UI updates)
